purpose: Propagate the Route A inbreeding-depression sensitivity into the natural near-versus-far deterministic backbone that supports the coarse directional island response.

intervention.all_other_base_config_values: identical to frozen Model 3 Chapter 2 bridge

uniform_negative_backbone_at_each_depres: mean effect at each of the three starting investment states < 0
0/128 histories are mixed in sign across starting states at epsilon 0
0/128 histories are positive-only across all starting states at epsilon 0
predeclared_decision_rule.conditional_uniformity_if: overall mean remains negative at depression 0.75 but mixed or positive-only histories appear, or any starting-state mean becomes non-negative

reporting_action.robust: retain directional deterministic backbone without an inbreeding-depression qualifier within the tested envelope
reporting_action.sign_reversal: state that the direction of the deterministic backbone is conditional on inbreeding depression
reporting_action.conditional_uniformity: retain a negative mean backbone but remove the claim of uniform one-directional deterministic response across histories

claim_boundary: This is a sensitivity of the synthetic deterministic backbone, not a natural estimate of inbreeding depression.
Only the natural near/far bridge is tested; richness matching, pooling and large-capacity interventions are not rerun.
The visitor histories are unchanged because depression acts in the plant reproductive operator, not visitor assembly.
No ABM is required because the question concerns the deterministic backbone.
